headings.rules: Never center. Keep tight tracking. High contrast. Do not exceed text-4xl for the main dashboard header.

body.rules: Optimize for readability. Left-align dense content.

monospace.rules: CRITICAL: Must be used for all numerals, amounts, dates, account numbers, and masked PII data.

spacing_and_layout.container: w-full max-w-[1600px] mx-auto p-4 md:p-6 lg:p-8

structure.main_split: Left Sidebar (Col span 3) for Upload/Docs, Center Table (Col span 6) for Transactions, Right Panel (Col span 3) for Q&A.

borders_and_radii.shadows: shadow-sm only. Use 1px borders instead of heavy shadows.
borders_and_radii.surface_treatment: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Use border-collapse and exposed skeletal lines.

pii_masking_treatment.visuals: Pill chips or dotted underlines for masked values. Do not just use plaintext asterisks.
pii_masking_treatment.classes: inline-flex items-center px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-[2px] bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-300 font-mono text-xs tracking-widest relative overflow-hidden

safety_badges.visuals: Prominent indicator showing active content guardrails.
safety_badges.classes: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-sm bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-700 font-medium text-xs font-mono

spend_summary_cards.typography: Monospace metrics, very large (text-3xl). Label in overline format (uppercase, wide tracking).

drag_drop_upload.visuals: Dashed border area with a technical scanning aesthetic. Use Lucide icons like FileText, Scan, ShieldCheck.
drag_drop_upload.classes: border-2 border-dashed border-zinc-300 hover:border-zinc-400 bg-white p-8 flex flex-col items-center justify-center transition-colors rounded-sm

q_and_a_chat.visuals: High-contrast terminal or structured chat interface. RAG sources should look like footnotes or citation chips.
q_and_a_chat.ai_bubble: bg-white border border-zinc-200 text-zinc-800 rounded-sm p-3
q_and_a_chat.input: rounded-none border-b border-zinc-300 bg-transparent focus:outline-none focus:border-zinc-900 focus:ring-0

transactions_table.visuals: Dense, tabular data. Monospace columns for amount and dates.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Strict contrast shifts. bg-white to hover:bg-zinc-50.
motion_and_interactions.animations: Micro-interactions for scanning/uploading PDFs. Use a 'Tracing Beam' or sweeping gradient effect on the upload zone when active.

iconography.style: Technical, sharp. Use stroke-width 1.5 for a finer, more precise look.

image_urls.description: Monochrome texture, can be used as a very faint background pattern (opacity-5) for the empty state of the document viewer.

assets.notes: Images are kept minimal as this is a highly functional, data-dense compliance tool. Rely heavily on typography and structural layout.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid in kebab-case format (e.g., data-testid='upload-pdf-dropzone', data-testid='chat-submit-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 'Control Room' grid system for layout density.
Implement the custom PII masking treatment meticulously using the provided markup structure.
Do not use generic Shadcn Cards with heavy shadows; strip shadows and enforce 1px borders and sharp/small radiuses.
Ensure all monetary values and masked fields use 'JetBrains Mono'.
Avoid centering content inside cards/tables; left-align data for scannability.
Use standard HTML tags augmented by Tailwind for layout wrappers, but utilize customized Shadcn components for complex interactions (Tables, Inputs, Dialogs).
